tools.name: ask_genaya
tools.description: Ask Genaya AI one plain-language question about the connected member's own organization (schedule, clients, leads, invoices, payments, expenses, calls, tasks, team) and get a markdown answer plus structured blocks (tables, stats, lists) with the counting definition when there is one. One call is one

tools.name: cancel_action
tools.description: Drop one proposal the member declined or no longer wants: pass its action_id. A proposal still waiting (or a held send not yet out) is canceled and nothing runs; one that already ran answers its state - use undo_action for that. Free.

tools.name: confirm_action
tools.description: Confirm one proposal genaya_act returned with confirm_channel in_chat, after the member said yes: pass its action_id and body_hash exactly as returned. A changed proposal is refused (ask again), an already-confirmed one replays its receipt, and a genaya_page proposal answers needs_human with a fresh

tools.name: genaya_act
tools.description: Run Genaya AI on one request that may CHANGE something (a task, client, lead, appointment, estimate or invoice draft, expense, a reschedule, cancel or complete, a text or email) as the connected member. Nothing runs here: each proposal comes back in actions with its preview and body_hash. confirm_ch

tools.name: list_actions
tools.description: List the connected member's own Genaya AI actions from any surface, newest first (at most 25), or one by action_id - the way to learn the outcome after the member confirmed on a Genaya page. Optional status filter. Read-only, free.

tools.name: undo_action
tools.description: Reverse one change that already ran, within its undo window (15 minutes): pass its action_id. A created record is removed, an edit is put back, a held message is withdrawn. Sent messages cannot be undone. Free.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Identify the connected member and organization: name and role, the organization's industry, its words for client and appointment, time zone, currency and plan, the scopes this connection holds, whether actions are available on this connection (and why not when they are not: every change that is not

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ask_genaya, whoami · Private data: ask_genaya, undo_action, whoami · Public sink: cancel_action, genaya_act · Destructive: cancel_action, genaya_act.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ask_genaya, whoami · Private data: ask_genaya, undo_action, whoami · Public sink: cancel_action, genaya_act · Destructive: cancel_action, genaya_act

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
